summary: Optionally add podman-compose support (EPEL, podman-compose, enable podman.service) and ADD config.yaml /etc/flightctl/ for early binding, then set OCI_REGISTRY, OCI_IMAGE_REPO and OCI_IMAGE_TAG and run sudo podman build -t ${OCI_IMAGE_REPO}:${OCI_IMAGE_TAG} .
